players.product: large gas/diesel reciprocating gensets (PGM130, 10 MW medium-speed gas platform) and Solar Turbines gas turbines for data-center prime and backup power

quarterly_data.signal: Caterpillar's 10-K states the dollar amount of backlog believed to be firm was approximately $51.2 billion at December 31, 2025 versus $30.0 billion at December 31, 2024, with the order backlog up across the primary segments and the largest increase in Power & Energy. Approximately $19.3 billion of the December 31, 2025 backlog was not expected to be filled in 2026.
quarterly_data.figure: firm backlog ~$51.2 billion (December 31, 2025) vs $30.0 billion (December 31, 2024); ~$19.3 billion not expected to be filled in 2026

quarterly_data.signal: The 10-K's 2026 outlook anticipates Power Generation growth for both reciprocating engines and turbines and turbine-related services, driven by increasing energy demand to support data center build-out related to cloud computing and generative AI, and says orders for prime power are trending higher as data center customers look for alternative power solutions. The capital expenditure reconciliation lists Power & Energy segment capital expenditures of 1,774 in 2025, 1,279 in 2024 and 944 in 2023 (millions of dollars).
